note: Data API root: https://<domain>/api/1.1/obj/<type> ; Workflow API root: https://<domain>/api/1.1/wf/<endpoint>. Per-type allowed operations are governed by privacy rules (see database.json privacy_rules) and API tokens. The tokens themselves live in settings.secure.api_tokens and are preserved by bubble_secrets.py into <workdir>/secrets/.env (BUBBLE_API_TOKEN_*).
